instruction: I want VLC to start videos in paused state instead of playing automatically when I open them. How can I configure VLC to always start paused?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
